RV Spots

Full-hookup park spots

Bring your own RV and park it on a level, full-hookup site with a paved cement pad — 30/50-amp power, water, and sewer, by the month or the season. Two spots are gravel instead of paved, each with its own covered canopy.

See available spots
On-site amenities

A shared laundry & washroom facility, right on the property.

RV spot guests have access to our on-site laundry and washroom building — no need to leave the park to do a load of laundry during your stay.

Privacy Policy

How we collect, use, and protect the information you share with us.

Last updated: August 2026

Mount Rental Enterprises LLC ("we," "us," or "our") operates this website. This policy explains how we handle the information you share with us.

Information We Collect

When you contact us through our website, call, or book a rental, we may collect information you provide directly, including your name, email address, phone number, and any details you share in a message (such as your preferred dates or the type of rental you're interested in).

How We Use Your Information

We use the information you provide to:

  • Respond to your inquiries and booking requests
  • Confirm and manage reservations
  • Send booking-related updates, such as confirmations or reminders
  • Improve our services and website

We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

Third-Party Services

Our site embeds a Google Maps view to help you find our location. Google may collect data according to its own privacy policy when that map loads. We do not control or take responsibility for third-party data practices.

Data Retention

We retain contact and booking information for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes described above, or as required by law.

Your Rights

You can ask us at any time to review, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you. To request deletion, email mountrental2@gmail.com with the subject “Data Deletion Request,” or call 337-526-1582. We'll confirm by email once it's been completed, typically within a few business days.

Contacting Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, reach out at mountrental2@gmail.com or 337-526-1582.

Terms of Service

The terms and conditions that apply when you rent from Mount Rental Enterprises.

Last updated: August 2026

These Terms of Service govern your use of this website and any rental booked with Mount Rental Enterprises LLC ("we," "us," or "our").

Rental Agreement

All RV, mobile home, and RV spot rentals are subject to a separate written rental agreement signed at the time of booking. These Terms of Service provide a general overview and do not replace that agreement.

Booking & Payment

Bookings are confirmed once availability is verified and any required deposit is received. Rates listed on this site are subject to change and are confirmed at the time of booking.

Cancellations

Cancellation terms vary by rental type and length of stay. Specific cancellation and refund terms will be provided at the time of booking and outlined in your signed rental agreement.

Renter Responsibilities

  • Renters must be at least 18 years old and, for RV rentals, hold a valid driver's license and proof of insurance.
  • Units must be returned in the condition they were received, ordinary wear and tear excepted.
  • Renters are responsible for any damage beyond normal wear and tear occurring during the rental period.

Liability

Mount Rental Enterprises is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of a rented RV, mobile home, or RV spot, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

Governing Law

These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Louisiana, without regard to conflict of law principles.

Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. Continued use of our services after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

Cookie Policy

How this website uses cookies and similar technologies.

Last updated: September 2026

This Cookie Policy explains how Mount Rental Enterprises LLC ("we," "us," or "our") uses cookies and similar technologies on this website.

What Cookies Are

Cookies are small text files placed on your device by websites you visit. They're commonly used to make sites work, remember preferences, and understand how visitors use a site.

Cookies We Use

This site does not require you to log in or create an account, so it does not set essential authentication cookies. The cookies that may be set come from third-party services embedded on this site:

  • Google Analytics — helps us understand how visitors use this site (pages viewed, general location, device type) so we can improve it. You can opt out using your browser's cookie settings or a tool like Google's Analytics opt-out browser add-on.
  • Google Maps — the embedded map on our Contact page may set cookies through Google to load and display map content.
  • Google Fonts — used to load the typefaces on this site. Loading fonts from Google's servers may involve a request to Google, governed by Google's own privacy practices.

Managing Cookies

You can choose which categories of cookies to allow using the cookie preferences banner shown when you first visit this site. To change your choice at any time afterward, click the cookie preferences button in the bottom-left corner of the screen. Most browsers also let you block or delete cookies through their own settings. Blocking cookies from Google Maps or Google Fonts may affect how parts of this site display or function, such as the embedded map.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in the tools we use on this site. Check back periodically for updates.

Contact

Questions about this Cookie Policy can be directed to mountrental2@gmail.com or 337-526-1582.
